name: file_delete
title: Delete File or Directory
description: Deletes an allowlisted file/symlink leaf or explicitly recursive directory on an explicitly selected HHC client after destructive host-policy admission.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

path.description: Absolute path of the file, symlink leaf, or directory to delete on the selected client.

recursive.description: Also delete directory contents; required for a non-empty directory.
